description: Queue a new vault for a draft or failed deployment using the same backend as Business UI. Read deploy options first. Gas is billed to prepaid balance on mainnet; Test gas produces informational cost estimates without balance funding, reservations or debits. HTTP 202 is queued, not confirmed: poll yield_deployments_get for pending/deploying/deployed/failed, failureReason and deployTxHash. Never blindly retry after a timeout; inspect status and locked deploySettings first. Requires JWT.

initialUserBP.description: Depositor yield share in basis points. The API checks it against the platform fee.

mode.description: Network mode; required unless exactly one key mode is cached.

name: yield_deployments_deploy
title: Deploy a new yield vault
